page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9T24 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, it features 48 physical cores with a single thread per core, running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance characteristics across multiple domains. The CPU excels in multi-core operations, as evidenced by a stress-ng multi-core score of 73,784.26 and a PassMark CPU score of 63,050.64, both placing in the top 25%. Memory performance is particularly notable, with a PassMark memory score in the top 10% and cached small-block read bandwidth reaching 3,647.99 GB/sec. However, uncached large-block read and write memory bandwidths drop to average levels of 111.38 GB/sec and 83.58 GB/sec, respectively. Cryptographic and integer operations are highly efficient, supported by hardware-level instruction sets such as AVX-512, AES, and SHA_NI.

The instance offers a balanced resource profile, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring high CPU density and strong memory performance without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, requiring reliance on external storage volumes for persistent data. Given its strong multi-threaded performance and high database operation benchmarks, the ecs.g8a.12xlarge is well-suited for enterprise applications, multi-threaded software compilation, database operations, and redis-based caching layers.
